verified_facts.text: The hotel's interiors are by Jacques Garcia, in a Belle Epoque-inspired style that recalls 19th-century Paris.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our hotel is a haven of Belle Époque-inspired elegance, where sumptuous interiors by Jacques Garcia recall the bygone glamor of 19th-century Paris.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is a boutique hotel in Seoul's Myeongdong neighborhood, near N Seoul Tower, Namdaemun Market and Deoksu-gung Palace.
verified_facts.excerpt: is near many leading attractions, including N Seoul Tower, Namdaemun Market, and Deoksu-gung Palace.

verified_facts.text: The hotel's address is 67 Toegye-ro, Jung-gu, Seoul.
Nearby transport includes Hoehyeon (Namdaemun Market) subway station and Seoul Station.

verified_facts.text: Rooms blend Belle Epoque charm with modern-day comfort.
verified_facts.excerpt: Unwind in luxury Myeongdong, Seoul hotel rooms​ blending Belle Époque charm with modern-day comfort

verified_facts.text: The top three suite categories feature a mini kitchen, suited to longer stays.
verified_facts.excerpt: For longer stays, consider one of our top three suite categories, which feature a mini kitchen

verified_facts.text: The top suite is a two-bedroom Presidential Suite.
verified_facts.excerpt: 2 Bedroom Presidential Suite, Bedroom 1: 1 King, Bedroom 2: 1 King

verified_facts.text: Marque d'Amour is a high-rise cocktail bar where guests can watch the sunset over creative cocktails.
verified_facts.excerpt: Admire breathtaking sunsets whilst savoring creative cocktails made by our expert mixologists.

verified_facts.text: The Tea Salon, inspired by the salons of France, serves coffee, tea and desserts.
verified_facts.excerpt: Inspired by the salons of France where art and culture freely intermingled, Tea Salon presents you relaxation with a cup of coffee, tea, and desserts.

verified_facts.text: The Swiss Perfection Spa has two treatment rooms and offers bespoke beauty and wellness treatments using Swiss Perfection products.
verified_facts.excerpt: a tranquil sanctuary of relaxation and rejuvenation with two exclusive treatment rooms. Bespoke beauty and wellness treatments combine advanced Swiss technology with indulgent Swiss Perfection products.
Open 24/7, our Fitness Center offers state-of-the-art equipment.

verified_facts.text: La Maison Boutique is the hotel's club lounge, with breakfast, Sweet Delight and a curated happy hour.
verified_facts.excerpt: Discover L’Escape’s signature boutique spaces. Enjoy refined service, an exquisite breakfast, Sweet Delight, and a curated happy hour.

verified_facts.text: The La Maison Boutique lounge is for guests 18 and older.
Self parking on site is complimentary for guests.
verified_facts.excerpt: Self parking is complimentary for guests.

verified_facts.text: The hotel has event spaces for celebrations, corporate functions and boutique weddings.
verified_facts.excerpt: also features elevated events spaces for celebrations, corporate functions, and boutique weddings.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is The Green Key certified.
Guests must be at least 19 to check in.
L'Amant Secret serves French fine dining and wines on the 26th floor, with views.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located on the 26th floor, L'Amant Secret combines exquisite gastronomy and superb wines with spectacular views.
